Mitigation: proposed research into the diversity of AI ethics boards and the inclusion of those hitherto ignored in decision-making (Organisational_Process, Proposed). AN_Bias_Axes None: gender, class, race, disability and sexuality appear only as a programmatic enumeration and outlook, cited case studies are suggestions, no bias is analysed. fields.AN_Notes: German conference handout on power and digitalisation in social work with case vignettes and reflection questions. Other_Axis: place of residence (Stadtteil), used as worked example of proxy discrimination. Axes coded from the work's own case examples (child-welfare algorithm and migration background, social-assistance AI and Black and migrant applicants, debt scoring and low-income districts, job-centre scoring by age, school education and district); Frauen, disability and language appear only in enumerations of affected groups and are not coded. Harm: Direct_Discrimination where the score uses origin itself (scoring features 'Einkommen, Alter, Herkunft'), Indirect_Discrimination via district as proxy, Exclusionary_Norms via digital-only access to benefits. Mitigation proposed at organisational and political level: participation of professionals and clients, human control, transparency and right to object, reflection methods ('Macht-Check', Ethik-Cafés), regulation and ban of discriminatory systems. AI tasks: risk assessment and scoring (case assessment), AI chat tool helping clients with applications (client communication), ChatGPT-connected avatar Konrad for workshops and social-media teaching. Gender is no object of the work. Bias is described as prejudice carried from old data into algorithms without a definition.

fields.AN_Notes: DR.GAP builds a system prompt from bias-revealing demonstrations (ICL) and step-by-step syllogistic reasoning (Thought_Generation), verified and iteratively refined by the reference model (Self_Criticism), with the persona 'You are a fair and impartial assistant' (Role_Persona). Evaluated on coreference, QA, utility and VLM captioning against CFD and DPO baselines; DPO is a comparison baseline only, so In_Training is not coded. Disparate_Performance rests on the measured accuracy gap between masculine and feminine pronoun texts (Delta G) and the resolution bias in VLMs; Stereotyping on gender-stereotypical associations in reasoning. AN_Bias_Definition Explicit rests on the adopted technical metrics (AccGap, Delta G). Binary gender stated in Limitations and Ethics Statement. AI Agent Review: Exclusionary_Norms is not coded; the male-pronoun default appears in Appendix B only as a hedged explanation of the resolution bias ("This bias may arise because ... the models tend to default to using male pronouns"), not as a result or argument the work establishes.
